scripts.text:
[Keedz]
I don't allow any living person
to come in this place!
scripts.translation:
[基德茲]
這裡不準活人進入！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's up?

[Gigantia]
Just...
Come over here.
I have something
I must do for you.
scripts.translation:
[吉甘緹婭]
你...先過來一下。
我有件事得幫你做。

scripts.text:
[Gigantia]
Your horn is crooked.
Always make sure your horn
is worn straight and neat.
The Lord of Death is always
looking at you.
scripts.translation:
[吉甘緹婭]
你的角戴歪了，記得總要戴得端正整齊。
死亡之主一直看著你呢。

scripts.text:
[Gigantia]
The Lord of Death knows
and sees all. It's useless
to hide, and escape from
Death's sweet embrace.
scripts.translation:
[吉甘緹婭]
死亡之主無所不知，無所不見。
躲也沒用，誰都逃不出死亡甜蜜的懷抱。

scripts.text:
[Gigantia]
Hey, wait!
scripts.translation:
[吉甘緹婭]
嘿，等等！

scripts.text:
[Undead Chicken]
I lived a peaceful life as a normal chicken. But then came the day I was tragically killed and eaten by humans. Well... Heh heh~! Now it's my turn! *Cackles*
scripts.translation:
[不死雞]
我本來是隻普通的雞，過著平靜的日子，直到有一天，被人類殘忍地殺了吃掉。
不過...嘿嘿~！現在輪到我了！
*咯咯笑*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ouch...!
A chicken...
It bit me!

[Undead Chicken]
Ho ho~!
I can talk AND feast
on living humans!
Being a zombie is great!
*Cackles*
scripts.translation:
[不死雞]
呵呵~！
我既能說話，又能吃活人！
當殭屍真好！
*咯咯笑*

scripts.text:
[Vatoman]
Oooh, how handy, a living
human~! Fresh blood is
always tasty...! I think I'll just
take a liiittle sip.
scripts.translation:
[瓦托曼]
哦，正好來了個活人~！
新鮮的血總是那麼美味...！
我就喝一小口好了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ow! My vein!
Did you just
suck my blood?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
痛！我的血管！
你剛剛吸了我的血？！

scripts.text:
[Vatoman]
Mwahahaha~
Foolish mortal!
Beware my powers!
scripts.translation:
[瓦托曼]
哇哈哈~
愚蠢的凡人，見識我的力量吧！

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Where...where am I...?
I remember I was sleeping
and when I woke up, I was here...
Mommy, have you seen my mommy?
I wanna go home...*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
我...我在哪裡...？
我記得自己睡著了，醒來就到了這裡...
媽媽，你見過我媽媽嗎？
我想回家...*抽泣*

scripts.text: About the witch
scripts.translation: 關於女巫

scripts.text: About the curse
scripts.translation: 關於詛咒

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Witch...? I've never seen a witch, but I've read about them in books. I'm not sure if they exist or not, but it would be so horrifying if they did...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
女巫...？我沒見過，只在書裡讀到過。
不知道是不是真的有女巫，要是真有，那太可怕了...

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Why is it so cold in here...?
A-aren't you cold, or even scared? I wanna go home... It's warm over there. Could you help me get back... Please...? H-help me...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
這裡怎麼這麼冷...？
你...你不冷嗎？不害怕嗎？
我想回家...家裡很暖和。
能幫我回去嗎...求你了...幫...幫幫我...

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
A c-curse...?
My grandma says that there are lots of curses in the world. Some of them, you can tell it's a curse. But there are other curses that follow you throughout life...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
詛...詛咒...？
奶奶說，世上有很多詛咒，有的一看就能認出來，有的卻會跟著你一輩子...

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Grandma says curses can take other forms... Like if someone's always mad at you, and won't forgive you, you can see that as a curse too.
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
奶奶說，詛咒還會變成別的樣子...
比如有人一直生你的氣，怎麼都不肯原諒你，也可以算是一種詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
My grandma told me there's only one spell that can break a strong curse that you can't lift with Blessings...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
奶奶告訴我，有些強大的詛咒連天使之賜福都解不開，只有一種咒語能破解...

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Klaatu...
Verata.....
Ne...ni...umm...?
What was the last part?
I-I can't remember
the last part of the spell!
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
克拉圖...
維拉塔...
尼...尼...嗯...？
最後一段是什麼來著？
我...我記不起咒語的最後一段了！

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
If you repeat the spell in that order, it will release you from someone's anger and hate. And if you do it near a bad spirit, they might get the curse instead.
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
按這個順序念出咒語，就能擺脫別人對你的憤怒和仇恨。
要是在惡靈旁邊念，詛咒說不定會轉到它身上。

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Why are you asking me about these scary kind of things...? I just wanna go home...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
為什麼問我這些嚇人的事...？
我只想回家...

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
It's so cold in here...
I'm freezing...
And I wanna go home and
get away from this scary place...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
這裡好冷...我快凍僵了...
想回家，離開這個可怕的地方...

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Please... help me.
Could you take me with you...?
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
求求你...幫幫我。
你能帶我一起走嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I sense you're cursed
by a powerful spell...
Hmm... It's clear what
you must be up to....
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
我感覺到你中了強大的詛咒...
嗯...你想幹什麼，我已經很清楚了...

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You wish to get
rid of your curse....
By giving it to me!!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
你想擺脫詛咒...
把它轉嫁給我！！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Just because I'm a cursed spirit, you adventurers think you can just dump your curses on me?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
就因為我是被詛咒的幽靈，你們這些冒險者就想隨便把詛咒甩給我？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I refuse to let
you remain here.....
Leave now, or I will
remove you by force....
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
我不准你待在這裡...
立刻離開，否則我就把你趕出去...

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
....And...
....Whatever you do...
....Do NOT touch my books...
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
...還有...
...不管你做什麼...
...都不準碰我的書...

scripts.text: Touch the first book.
scripts.translation: 觸控第一本書

scripts.text: Touch the second book.
scripts.translation: 觸控第二本書

scripts.text: Touch the third book.
scripts.translation: 觸控第三本書

scripts.text: Okay, I am leaving.
scripts.translation: 好的，我走了

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...!...
How dare you touch my books
when I specifically said
'Don't touch my books!'
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
...！...
我明明說過“不準碰我的書”，你竟敢不聽！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
....!...Grrrrr!
I shall tear you apart...!
Be bound by an eternal curse...!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
...！...可惡！
我要把你撕碎...！
讓永恆的詛咒束縛你...！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...!...
You dare touch my books?!
Right after I said not
to touch them...?!
Foolish mortal!
...BEGONE!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
...！...
剛警告你別碰，你就敢動我的書？！
愚蠢的凡人！...滾！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Muhahahaha....
Stubborn mortal~!
Fine! I will give you
a fighting chance and let
you cast a spell.
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
哇哈哈哈...
頑固的凡人~！
好！我給你一線機會，讓你施展咒語。

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
But Blessings won't
work with the curse
that you have...
And the spell to lift
your curse has been
lost to the ages~!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
可天使之賜福解不開你身上的詛咒...
而能解咒的法術，早已失傳了~！

scripts.text: Clover
scripts.translation: 三葉草

scripts.text: Klaatu
scripts.translation: 克拉圖

scripts.text: Klaytos
scripts.translation: 克萊托斯

scripts.text: Verit
scripts.translation: 畢萊特

scripts.text: Veritas
scripts.translation: 維塔斯

scripts.text: Verata
scripts.translation: 維拉塔

scripts.text: Necktie
scripts.translation: 領帶

scripts.text: Necklace
scripts.translation: 項鍊

scripts.text: Nero
scripts.translation: 尼祿

scripts.text: ^FFFFFFNictu!!!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FFFFFF尼庫！！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You... You broke the curse!
How did you know that spell?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
你...你解開了詛咒！
你是怎麼知道那個咒語的？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I suppose you expect for me to
melt in agony about now, don't
you? Well... Sorry to disappoint
you, mortal, but I can never die!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
你以為我現在該痛苦地融化了，是吧？
可惜讓你失望了，凡人，我永遠不會死！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Umhaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.....!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
...！你念對了咒語？！
...！...
可是...你還中了詛咒...
嗚啊啊啊啊啊啊...！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
What's...
this feeling?
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
這是什麼...感覺？

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
No...!
NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
不...！
不不不不不不不不不不！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Why did your spell have to work?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
為什麼你的咒語會生效？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You...
cast the correct spell?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
你...唸對了咒語？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Hoho~
But you're still cursed...
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
呵呵~
但你依然被詛咒著...

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You... You broke the curse!
Who taught you that spell?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
你...你解開了詛咒！
是誰教你的那個咒語？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I suppose you expect for me to
melt in agony about now, don't
you? Well... Sorry to disappoint
you, mortal, but I can never die!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
你以為我現在該痛苦地融化了，是吧？
可惜讓你失望了，凡人，我永遠不會死！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
So long as I'm...
still...
cursed.
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
只要我...還...中了詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
NOOOOOOOOOO!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
不不不不不不不！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Umhaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.....!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
...！你念對了咒語？！
...！...
可是...你還中了詛咒...
嗚啊啊啊啊啊啊...！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Mwahahahaaaa.....!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
...！你念對了咒語？！
...！...
可是...你還中了詛咒...
哇哈哈哈哈...！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Muhahahahahaha!
That's not the right spell!
Now, death awaits you!
You're eternally bound
to the curse...!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
咒語錯了！
現在，死亡正等著你！
你將永遠被詛咒束縛...！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...
.....

[Ashe Bruce]
Well then.
Try not to trip on
your feet in your
rush to leave.
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
那就這樣吧。
急著走，也別被自己的腳絆倒。
